article.headline: Amani Lyles posts double-double to lead Akron over Bowling Green 77-67
article.description: — Amani Lyles totaled 18 points and 10 rebounds to help Akron defeat Bowling Green 77-67 on Friday night.
article.linkText: Amani Lyles posts double-double to lead Akron over Bowling Green 77-67
article.story: BOWLING GREEN, Ohio -- — Amani Lyles totaled 18 points and 10 rebounds to help Akron defeat Bowling Green 77-67 on Friday night. Bowen Hardman added 15 points for the Zips (12-4, 3-1 Mid-American Conference). Eric Mahaffey had 14 points and went 6 of 10 from the field with a 3-pointer. The Falcons (11-6, 2-3) were led by Mayar Wol, who finished with 32 points. Javontae Campbell added 12 points, six rebounds, five assists and four steals. Akron took the lead with 18:49 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Hardman led with 12 points at the break for a 43-27 advantage. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
